title: Remote Jobs Feed input
description: All filters are optional. With no input the Actor returns the 50 newest remote jobs from both sources posted in the last 7 days.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which public job feeds to read. Both permit reuse with attribution; every row links back to the listing on its source.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keep jobs whose title, company, tags, category or description contains ANY of these words (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeTerms.title: Exclude terms
excludeTerms.description: Drop jobs whose title or company contains ANY of these words.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: Match the location restriction text of the posting, for example USA, Europe, Canada. Use Worldwide to keep only jobs open to applicants anywhere.

categories.title: Categories contain
categories.description: Keep jobs whose category or industry contains ANY of these words, for example engineering, marketing, design.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Keep only these employment types. Leave empty for all.

requireSalary.title: Only jobs with a salary
requireSalary.description: Keep only postings that state a salary or salary range.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Ignore older postings. 0 means no limit. Jobicy only serves the last 7 days, so larger values mostly affect Remotive.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Upper bound on rows saved, and therefore on cost: each saved job is one billable event.

includeDescription.title: Description format
includeDescription.description: Full job description as plain text, original HTML, or omitted to keep rows small.

dedupe.title: Merge duplicates
dedupe.description: When the same company posts the same title on both sources, keep one row and list the other link under alsoListedOn.
